query:
SELECT COALESCE(g.monthly_budget_usd <= (
            SELECT COALESCE(sum(u.cost_usd), 0)
            FROM usage_events u
            WHERE u.agent_id=g.id AND u.created_at >= date_trunc('month', clock_timestamp(), 'UTC')
        ), false) AS "exhausted!"
        FROM agents g
        WHERE g.id=$1
